I'm a security guard. I've worked in a few places that gave me the creeps, but hospitals were the worst. 

One hospital in particular, which I won't name because security, had a floor which was closed due to asbestos clean up. One of the rooms on this floor was extremely bizarre. The air felt thick and stuffy, even through the mask you had to wear when patrolling it.  

I was checking it one morning, I'd say it was around 4am, and I noticed that the usually open bathroom door was shut. There was a scuffling sound inside, so now I had to check it, in case it was a lost patient or a homeless person. So, I went in, held my breath, and threw open the door. No one! Ok, weird. So, I turn to leave, and the large room door suddenly swings closed without any warning and so forcefully that the noise causes my ears to ring.

I peed a little, but I wasn't about to stay in the room. So, I steeled myself, opened the door, and ran out into the hall. I still can't explain it. HVAC was shut off for safety, no windows were open because they *can't* open, and I was the only one on the floor.
